edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside mintFunkyMonkeyFratHouse.
onlyOwner compares owner() with the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyTreasury compares msg.sender with the treasury address.
initDropConfigTogaParty is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
initDropConfigGreekLife is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
initDropConfigPirateParade is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
flipSale is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseURI is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setPricePerNFT is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxMintsPerTransaction is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setPlaceholderURI is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setTreasuryWallet is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
claimETH is guarded by the onlyTreasury modifier.
onlyOwner invokes owner() to obtain the privileged account.
owner() returns the _owner storage value.
onlyOwner authorises based on the stored _owner compared to msg.sender.
constructor assigns the treasury address from its argument.
constructor calls setBaseURI to initialise the base URI.
constructor writes the initial placeholderURI.
Ownable constructor sets _owner to the deployer.
uses blockhash/block.number to derive drops[0].startingIndex.
uses blockhash/block.number to derive drops[1].startingIndex.
uses blockhash/block.number to derive drops[2].startingIndex.
_safeMint performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient.
mint relies on SafeMath add/mul over supply, price and token count.
claimETH transfers the whole balance to the treasury via an external call.
treasury is both the authorisation subject and the ETH recipient of claimETH.
setTreasuryWallet overwrites the treasury state variable.
constructor initialises the treasury variable.
setPricePerNFT updates PRICE.
mint requires msg.value to cover PRICE.mul(numberOfTokens).
PRICE participates in SafeMath multiplication during minting.
setMaxMintsPerTransaction updates maxMintPerTransaction.
mint enforces numberOfTokens <= maxMintPerTransaction.
setPlaceholderURI updates placeholderURI.
tokenURI returns placeholderURI when startingIndex is unset.
mint requires publicSaleIsActive and can flip it to false.
flipSale writes publicSaleIsActive.
mint reads and mutates drops for the active drop and starting index block.
tokenURI reads the Drops struct to compute the shifted token id.
initDropConfigTogaParty rewrites drops[0] and resets the other drops.
initDropConfigGreekLife rewrites drops[1] and resets the other drops.
initDropConfigPirateParade rewrites drops[2] and resets the other drops.
mint enforces totalSupply + numberOfTokens <= TOTAL_SUPPLY.
TOTAL_SUPPLY is compared against a SafeMath addition of the supply.
numberOfTokens drives the supply, price and loop checks in mint.
_fromIndex is stored into drops[0].
_toIndex is stored into drops[0].
_totalAmount is stored into drops[0] and used as the starting index modulus.
_activateStartingIndex triggers the blockhash based index computation.
_dropIsActive sets the drop active flag.
_fromIndex is stored into drops[1].
_toIndex is stored into drops[1].
_totalAmount is stored into drops[1] and used as the starting index modulus.
_activateStartingIndex triggers the blockhash based index computation.
_dropIsActive sets the drop active flag.
_fromIndex is stored into drops[2].
_toIndex is stored into drops[2].
_totalAmount is stored into drops[2] and used as the starting index modulus.
_activateStartingIndex triggers the blockhash based index computation.
_dropIsActive sets the drop active flag.
_isActive is written into publicSaleIsActive.
_price is written into PRICE.
_maxMintPerTransaction is written into maxMintPerTransaction.
_placeholderURI is written into placeholderURI.
_treasury is written into the treasury state variable.
_baseURI is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
tokenId selects the applicable drop and the returned URI.
mintIndex is the tokenId passed into the _safeMint callback.
